description: The line plot illustrates the performance of different trigger types—labeled as "start," "random," and "end"—across various word triggers, with the horizontal axis listing these triggers in ascending order based on the ASR of the clean model. The vertical axis represents the ASR (Attack Success Rate), ranging from 0.5 to 0.9, with values increasing in increments of 0.1. The "start" trigger, depicted by a green line with circular markers, begins at an ASR of approximately 0.76 for the "cf" trigger and generally trends upward, peaking at around 0.92 for the "athletics" trigger. The "random" trigger, shown as an orange line with cross markers, starts at about 0.66 for "cf" and exhibits a fluctuating pattern, reaching a peak of approximately 0.93 for "Estadio." The "end" trigger, represented by a purple line with circular markers, begins at around 0.76 for "cf," dips to about 0.57 for "bb," then rises sharply to a peak of approximately 0.96 for "Estadio," before declining to around 0.83 for "athletics." The legend in the bottom-right corner identifies each line by its color and marker style, corresponding to the respective trigger type.
